t.zh: 排序是程序，程序也能用等式定义。插入排序把元素一个个插进排好的列表。
t.en: Sorting is a program, and a program can be defined by equations. Insertion sort puts the elements one by one into a sorted list.

after.zh: 定义函数就是写程序，化简就是运行程序。
after.en: Defining a function is writing a program; Simp runs it.

brief.zh: 给每一行选一个右边，让每个测试都算对。
brief.en: Pick a right side for every row so that every test works out right.

hint.zh: if c then v else w：c 为真取 v，为假取 w。
hint.en: if c then v else w: v when c is true, w when it is false.

t.zh: 程序里的「如果」也是函数：按条件的真假，各写一行。
t.en: A program’s “if” is a function too: one row for each truth value of its condition.

choices: if(le(x, y), cons(x, cons(y, ys)), cons(y, ins(x, ys)))
if(le(x, y), cons(y, ins(x, ys)), cons(x, cons(y, ys)))

solution: if(le(x, y), cons(x, cons(y, ys)), cons(y, ins(x, ys)))

brief.zh: 给每一行选一个右边，让每个测试都算对。
brief.en: Pick a right side for every row so that every test works out right.

hint.zh: 拿 x 和列表的第一个 y 比。
hint.en: Compare x with the first of the list, y.

t.zh: ins 把一个数插进排好的列表，拆开的是第二个参数。
t.en: ins puts a number into a sorted list; it takes apart its second argument.

brief.zh: 给每一行选一个右边，让每个测试都算对。
brief.en: Pick a right side for every row so that every test works out right.

hint.zh: ins 要的是一个排好的列表。

tests.goal: ins(s(zero), cons(zero, cons(s(s(zero)), nil))) = cons(zero, cons(s(zero), cons(s(s(zero)), nil)))
ins(zero, cons(s(zero), nil)) = cons(zero, cons(s(zero), nil))
ins(s(s(zero)), cons(zero, nil)) = cons(zero, cons(s(s(zero)), nil))

brief.zh: 设计一个证明助手，证完每一个目标。
brief.en: Design a proof assistant that proves every goal.

hint.zh: 比大小、「如果」和插入的定义都要用。
hint.en: The definitions of comparison, if and insert are all needed.
